description: SYNTHETIC: ACE-PHE-NME with every torsion phase + 37 degrees
units: topology: e, Angstrom, kcal/mol, degrees (AMBER, harmonic k without 1/2); energy_kj_mol / forces_kj_mol_nm are OpenMM-native (F = -dE/dR); energy_hartree / gradient_hartree_bohr are dE/dR in ferric's units

provenance.coulomb_lj_split: XmlSerializer clones of the NonbondedForce: coulomb = particle and exception epsilons zeroed; lj = charges and chargeProds zeroed; each in its own System

perturbation.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).normal, applied in order perturbed_0p03 sigma=0.03 A, perturbed_0p10 sigma=0.1 A

coulomb_constant.note: ferric's Coulomb constant is exactly 1 Ha*Bohr; OpenMM's, converted with ferric's constants, is openmm_in_hartree_bohr. Reference Coulomb energies/forces exceed ferric's by this ratio.
